text: hey so now that i can make walls and floors and stuff, if you look we have had a fuckin horrible history of trying to solve the edge piece thing and i seemed to have solved it pretty easily by mistake, and the answer is just literally in looking at my 'thin_floor' and other pieces that are thin. when its thin it sits perfectly and you dont have to worry about weird shit from my experience so far [Image #20] [Image #21] compare those to this: [Image #22] lol
resolution: Thinned the floor plate from a fat 0.2m slab to 0.05m (split FLOOR_SIZE out of PLATE_SIZE in game/build/catalog.ts; floor.* point at it, roofs keep PLATE_SIZE since a flat roof underside is a visible ceiling). 0.05m keeps the plate sandwich non-degenerate so per-face floor skins and the 3-box bake survive, while the old curb lip / tall edge face (the 'edge piece' weird shit) all but vanishes. Walls rest on the new top via the existing read-time liftedWallBaseY (no hardcoded 0.2); updated placed.test wall-rest expectations 0.2 to 0.05. Verified: worldParity 16/16, roofs 9/9, worldGeometry floor 3-box+per-face-skin test green.
